title.sl: Nasprotje, namen, vzrok: although, despite, so that
title.de: Gegensatz, Zweck, Grund: although, despite, so that
title.it: Contrasto, scopo, causa: although, despite, so that
title.en: Contrast, purpose, cause: although, despite, so that

rule.sl:
**although**, **though**, **even though** (čeprav) + stavek: **Although it rained, we walked to the tarn.** **We walked, even though it rained.** Ena veznica je dovolj, angleščina nima zraven but.

**despite**, **in spite of** (kljub) + samostalnik ali -ing: **Despite the rain, we walked.** **In spite of the snow, the bus came.** **Despite feeling ill, she came.** Za despite ni of.

**however** (vendar) začne nov stavek, z vejico: **It rained. However, we walked.** V govoru **though** na koncu: **We walked, though.**

Namen: **to**, **in order to** + osnovna oblika: **Jack got up early in order to feed the sheep.** **so that** + stavek s can, could, will, would: **I left early so that I could catch the bus.** V govoru tudi samo **so**.

Vzrok: **because** + stavek, **because of** + samostalnik: **We stayed because of the snow.** **as a result** (zato) začne, kar je sledilo: **The road was closed. As a result, the bus didn't come.**
rule.de:
**although**, **though**, **even though** (obwohl) + Satz: **Although it rained, we walked to the tarn.** **We walked, even though it rained.** Ein Bindewort genügt, Englisch setzt kein but dazu.

**despite**, **in spite of** (trotz) + Nomen oder -ing: **Despite the rain, we walked.** **In spite of the snow, the bus came.** **Despite feeling ill, she came.** Nach despite kein of.

**however** (jedoch) beginnt einen neuen Satz, mit Komma: **It rained. However, we walked.** Gesprochen **though** am Ende: **We walked, though.**

Zweck: **to**, **in order to** + Grundform: **Jack got up early in order to feed the sheep.** **so that** + Satz mit can, could, will, would: **I left early so that I could catch the bus.** Gesprochen auch nur **so**.

Grund: **because** + Satz, **because of** + Nomen: **We stayed because of the snow.** **as a result** (infolgedessen) beginnt, was folgte: **The road was closed. As a result, the bus didn't come.**
rule.it:
**although**, **though**, **even though** (anche se, sebbene) + una frase: **Although it rained, we walked to the tarn.** **We walked, even though it rained.** Basta una congiunzione, l'inglese non ci aggiunge but.

**despite**, **in spite of** (nonostante) + un nome o -ing: **Despite the rain, we walked.** **In spite of the snow, the bus came.** **Despite feeling ill, she came.** Dopo despite niente of.

**however** (tuttavia) comincia una frase nuova, con la virgola: **It rained. However, we walked.** A voce **though** alla fine: **We walked, though.**

Lo scopo: **to**, **in order to** + la forma base: **Jack got up early in order to feed the sheep.** **so that** + una frase con can, could, will, would: **I left early so that I could catch the bus.** A voce anche solo **so**.

La causa: **because** + una frase, **because of** + un nome: **We stayed because of the snow.** **as a result** (di conseguenza) comincia ciò che è seguito: **The road was closed. As a result, the bus didn't come.**
rule.en:
**although**, **though**, **even though** + a sentence: **Although it rained, we walked to the tarn.** **We walked, even though it rained.** One joining word is enough: English adds no but.

**despite**, **in spite of** + a noun or -ing: **Despite the rain, we walked.** **In spite of the snow, the bus came.** **Despite feeling ill, she came.** No of after despite.

**however** starts a new sentence, with a comma: **It rained. However, we walked.** In talk, **though** at the end: **We walked, though.**

What for: **to**, **in order to** + the base form: **Jack got up early in order to feed the sheep.** **so that** + a sentence with can, could, will, would: **I left early so that I could catch the bus.** In talk also just **so**.

Why: **because** + a sentence, **because of** + a noun: **We stayed because of the snow.** **as a result** starts what followed: **The road was closed. As a result, the bus didn't come.**

rows: He got up early in order to feed the sheep.
I left early so that I could catch the bus.
We stayed because of the snow.
As a result, the bus didn't come.

rule.sl: + stavek: **although**, **even though**, **because**, **so that**. + samostalnik ali -ing: **despite**, **in spite of**, **because of**. Nov stavek: **However,** … **As a result,** … Namen: **to**, **in order to** + osnovna oblika.
rule.de: + Satz: **although**, **even though**, **because**, **so that**. + Nomen oder -ing: **despite**, **in spite of**, **because of**. Neuer Satz: **However,** … **As a result,** … Zweck: **to**, **in order to** + Grundform.
rule.it: + una frase: **although**, **even though**, **because**, **so that**. + un nome o -ing: **despite**, **in spite of**, **because of**. Frase nuova: **However,** … **As a result,** … Scopo: **to**, **in order to** + la forma base.
rule.en: + a sentence: **although**, **even though**, **because**, **so that**. + a noun or -ing: **despite**, **in spite of**, **because of**. A new sentence: **However,** … **As a result,** … What for: **to**, **in order to** + the base form.

tip.sl: 💡 *Čeprav … , pa …*: v angleščini samo ena beseda: **Although it rained, we walked.**
tip.it: 💡 *Anche se …, però …*: in inglese una sola parola: **Although it rained, we walked.**
tip.en: 💡 **despite** + a noun, **although** + a sentence; no of after despite.
